verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents Directory Insights, which aggregates and standardizes event logs across user activity and IT resources, and says directory events data can be managed and exported through RESTful commands. That covers the queryable, structured log and API-export parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows native streaming to a SIEM. Missing for 10: native SIEM streaming or connectors, detailed docs on the event-log API schema and query options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, every identity event is queryable and exportable — a structured system log with API access and native streaming to my SIEM

citations.quote: Directory Insights aggregates and standardizes event logs across user activity and every IT resource, and then surfaces them as instantly actionable data.
manage and export your directory events data through RESTful commands
